is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. (identified as Anopheles coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s.) from Cové, Benin (page 1, 4-5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: TaqMan assays were used to genotype Vgsc L1014F (L995F), L1014S (L995S), N1575Y (N1570Y), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) (page 4, page 6, page 8 Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (page 8) reports RR, RS, SS counts, total tested, and resistant allele frequencies for L1014F (RR=200, RS=41, SS=6, N=247), Ace-1 119S (RR=0, RS=2, SS=178, N=180), and N1575Y (RR=0, RS=1, SS=177, N=178).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae and wild adults from an experimental hut station in Cové, southern Benin (7°14'N, 2°18'E) (page 2-3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article characterizing the resistance profile, species composition, and resistance genetics of the local vector population.

sub_country_location.evidence: Cové Phase II experimental hut station (7°14'N, 2°18'E), southern Benin (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected between December 2013 and November 2014 (page 4, 8).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Field site is a PAMVERC experimental hut collaborative facility, but these are baseline characterization collections specifically conducted in 2013-2014.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and allele frequencies are fully provided in Table 2 of the main text; the supplement contains only microarray data.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. from an experimental hut station in Cové, southern Benin. Genotyping of Vgsc L1014F, L1014S, N1575Y, and Ace-1 G119S is reported with full genotype counts and allele frequencies. WHO tube bioassays and CDC bottle resistance intensity and synergist assays were also performed.
